LESSON: CONFLICT RESOLUTION

Grade: SNE  /  visual-impairment / Grade 10
Subject: COMMUNITY SERVICE LEARNING FOR LEARNERS WITH VISUAL IMPAIRMENT JUNE
Strand: Life Skills in Education
Topic 2.2: Conflict Resolution
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 6

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Conflict Resolution, part of Life Skills in Education in SNE  /  visual-impairment / Grade 10 COMMUNITY SERVICE LEARNING FOR LEARNERS WITH VISUAL IMPAIRMENT JUNE.

Key inquiry question: How can I contribute to positive conflict resolution in the community?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

SECTION 2: LEARNING OUTCOMES

By the end of this topic, you should be able to:

Refer to the KICD curriculum reference at the end of this lesson for the full list of outcomes.

SECTION 3: KEY CONCEPTS AND EXPLANATION

SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

A. At school

Follow your teacher’s guidance for group work, discussion, and practice on this topic.

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Conflict Resolution together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Core Competencies to be developed:
● Communication: Learners speak clearly as they brainstorm on situations of conflicts in the community and share in

class.

● Digital Literacy: Learners use digital devices with assistive technology to watch or listen to relevant video clips or

audio-visual clips on methods of solving conflicts in the community.

Values:
● Unity: Learners display team spirit, brainstorm on situations of conflicts in the community and share in class.

● Social justice: Learners observe fairness as they discuss ways of solving conflicts in their community.

Pertinent and Contemporary Issues:
(PCIs):

Peace Education: Learners journalise personal experiences on peaceful conflict resolution in the community.

Suggested learning resources:

Digital devices with assistive technology, braille reference materials, print reference materials with appropriate font and

colour contrast, print and braille learner’s books, braille and print writing materials.
